subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

(A) He usual jogs in the early morning, / (B) enjoying the fresh air and peaceful atmosphere / (C) while preparing for / (D) the upcoming marathon
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence lies in part **A**.
 
• The word "**usual**" is incorrectly used. The correct term should be "**usually**" to indicate frequency or habit.
 
• Thus, the correct phrase would be "**He usually jogs in the early morning**."
 
• The remaining parts of the sentence (B, C, and D) are grammatically correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is **A**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He usually jogs in the early morning, enjoying the fresh air and peaceful atmosphere while preparing for the upcoming marathon."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B: "enjoying the fresh air and peaceful atmosphere"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "while preparing for"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "the upcoming marathon"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
